crime.value: Murder of wife Miriam Chesterton by stabbing with scissors, staged as accidental death during a practical joke reenactment; central question: was it genuine accident or premeditated murder disguised as self-defense?
crime.quote: Harry Chesterton had finally found the one absolutely foolproof way to murder his wife.

victim.value: Miriam Chesterton, nagging wife of seven years whose constant criticism of Harry's get-rich-quick schemes and financial irresponsibility made her an obstacle to his ambitions and his pursuit of wealthy Cathy.
victim.quote: How could a man concentrate on his ambitions and plans and prospects with a nagging wife hounding him all the time?

closed_world.value: Two-family apartment building at 148 Coleridge Drive; bathroom as primary crime scene with neighbors in proximity; police and witnesses immediately present post-discovery.
closed_world.quote: The house was absolutely full of people. There were people with cameras and pieces of chalk and black bags crammed into the bathroom.

culprit_and_motive.value: Harry Chesterton, the husband, premeditated the murder over three years to marry wealthy Cathy and escape middle-class insecurity; motivated by greed, ambition, and escape from marital criticism.
culprit_and_motive.quote: After three years of careful planning, of working on and rejecting scheme after scheme after scheme, Harry Chesterton had finally found the one absolutely foolproof way to murder his wife.

resolution.value: Detective Hotchkiss grows suspicious after Harry kills a second man (with a beer bottle, mistaking a cigarette lighter for a gun) in nearly identical circumstance; pattern of violence and Harry's eventual mention of Cathy under interrogation exposes his motive.
resolution.quote: They talked for fourteen hours before Harry mentioned Cathy.

investigator.value: Detective Hotchkiss, weary but watchful police detective with institutional authority; his patient skepticism and pattern-recognition uncover the premeditation behind Harry's ostensibly foolproof alibi.
investigator.quote: Detective Hotchkiss, behind a perfunctory sympathy, was watchful and expressionless.
